chain_words.nuance: a brief mention of an event, written down for reference
a regular, dated entry of events as they happen
a general written account preserved for future reference
an ordered account of events across a period of time
a systematically preserved collection of official documents

explanation: These words all describe written accounts of the past, but with increasing scope and formality, from a brief note to an organised collection of preserved documents.

usage_notes.difference: 'Chronicle' describes an ordered narrative of events over time, while 'archive' describes a systematically preserved collection of documents.
